Source: https://github.com/heroui-inc/heroui

Reference: tag `v3.2.6`, commit `e385ac202b2cdb94b1bf6fa76d32c31c8259cc5e`.

Lenso UI modifies HeroUI's component styles and default theme into StyleX
styles and DTCG tokens. React Aria and Tailwind implementations are replaced
with Base UI and native HTML implementations. This is an independent
adaptation, not an official HeroUI release.

The HeroUI-derived work retains its Apache-2.0 terms. Lenso's original work
retains the repository's MIT terms. HeroUI names and marks are not licensed
for branding this project.
